subject: Compliance onboarding: certification timeline & questionnaire
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@curelyhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance onboarding: certification timeline & questionnaire

Hi Emma / Curely team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation and clear priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

1) Ask list you surfaced on the call
   - Confirm SOC 2 Type II evidence and scoping (systems + subservice providers)
   - HIPAA applicability and whether PHI will be processed/stored by our endpoints
   - Curely's vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned sending an initial file)

2) What Redwood will deliver this week
   - redwood-compliance-summary.pdf (attached) — SOC 2 Type II summary, controls owner map, and list of third-party subservices.
   - Preliminary answers to the Curely VSQ within 3 business days of receiving it.

3) Longer-term certifications you asked about
   - ISO 27001: logical next step — we can provide a mapping between our SOC 2 controls and ISO clauses; estimate 8–12 weeks for a full gap-remediation plan.
   - FedRAMP: we can run a suitability assessment but FedRAMP path requires dedicated engineering/legal work (we flagged this as a separate project).

4) Next meeting
   - Proposed: Thu Aug 20, 10:00–10:30 PT to review the VSQ and outstanding HIPAA scoping questions.

Please confirm the meeting time and forward the vendor questionnaire when convenient. Also, if Curely has a standard NDA, send it over; otherwise we'll circulate our standard NDA/BAA as needed.

Attachments: redwood-compliance-summary.pdf (short control summary + SOC2 report pointer)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0133

Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance onboarding: certification timeline & questionnaire

Vivek,

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our notes. Attached is the initial vendor security questionnaire (Curely_VSQ.xlsx). A few notes from our side: 

- HIPAA: Curely will be handling PHI for a portion of the workflow; we need confirmation that Redwood can sign a BAA and a high-level description of how PHI is protected in transit and at rest.
- SOC 2: request a copy of the latest Type II report (or a summary and scope) and the date range it covers.
- Timeline: our compliance team is aiming to complete vendor assessments within 3 weeks to stay on track for an Oct product pilot.

Procurement — please advise on NDA/PO process.

I can join the Aug 20 meeting; if you can make a short 30-minute slot, we'll walk through the VSQ prioritization.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Head of Security Operations
Curely Health
emma.jones@curelyhealth.com | (617) 555-0199

Attachments: Curely_VSQ.xlsx

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance onboarding: certification timeline & questionnaire

Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick internal plan so we can move fast once Curely returns the VSQ: 

- Owner: Ben will take point on the VSQ answers (controls + evidence). Ben, please review the Curely_VSQ.xlsx and flag any items needing engineering or legal input.
- Legal: we'll prepare a draft BAA and our standard NDA (I'll loop legal if we need a custom clause for FedRAMP discussions).
- Timeline estimates (internal):
   * VSQ response + evidence pack: target 10 business days after we receive the completed questionnaire back from Curely.
   * ISO 27001 mapping & remediation plan: 8–12 weeks to a formal gap report.
   * FedRAMP suitability assessment: 4 weeks for an internal review and proposal (not the authorization timeline).

I'll attach a short plan for owners and expected inputs. Ben — please schedule 1:1 with Marissa to collect the SOC artifacts and sample evidence.

Karthik
Director, Security Integrations
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: questionnaire-owner-plan.md

Emma / Curely procurement team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Two immediate items from Redwood:

1) DocuSign NDA: we have shared our standard NDA/BAA via DocuSign — link below. Please countersign so we can exchange SOC artifacts and PHI scoping documents securely.
   - DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/NDASC-2026-CH

2) Proposed next steps and owners
   - Ben Carter (copied) to complete the VSQ answers and upload supporting artifacts to the shared Drive area after NDA is executed.
   - Karthik will prepare a short ISO mapping brief for the Aug 20 meeting.
   - Proposed meeting: Thu Aug 20, 10:00–10:30 PT — confirm or propose an alternate slot.

We attach the NDA stub here as well (NDA-Redwood-Curely-2026.pdf). Once we have the signed NDA, we'll share the SOC 2 Type II report and a folder with sample control evidence.

If FedRAMP is a must-have for Curely, we can scope an assessment but it will need a separate SOW — we can discuss during follow-up.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
